observation: At 375x812, hamburger click expands .nav-inner; click on .nav-group-toggle #1 sets its aria-expanded=true and the adjacent .nav-group-panel display:block; click on .nav-group-toggle #2 sets #2 to aria-expanded=true and resets #1 to aria-expanded=false (closeAll in setupGroupDropdowns). Press Escape on #2 open: aria-expanded becomes false and focus returns to the toggle. Click outside any group: every group aria-expanded=false. Verified via getComputedStyle + getAttribute in Chromium 149 DevTools.
